## Context / Problem
Three interface-test files contain ten audited comment/docstring blocks. Scope was revalidated on `origin/main@0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e`; stable anchors separate the documentation block from the inline constant comment.

## Approach
Condense only the ten anchored blocks. Preserve non-docstring runtime strings, constants, fixture values, assertions, decorators, and executable statements.

Parse immutable before/final blobs with `type_comments=True`; remove only leading docstrings from modules, classes, functions, and async functions; normalize `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; and require the remaining ASTs to match. Restrict comment edits to named anchors and adjacent blank lines. Compare shebangs/directives byte-for-byte.

## Scope
- `tests/interfaces/io/test_export_ndjson_js_safe.py` — module docstring; documentation block bound to `_HLC_INEXACT_BASE_NS`; the separate inline `% 256` comment on that assignment; `ns_ticket` docstring; and `test_ns_ticket_timestamps_are_deterministically_float64_inexact` docstring. Retain the deterministic HLC seam, float64-inexact premise, decimal-string wire form, exact digits, and import coercion.
- `tests/interfaces/io/test_import_batch_resume.py` — module docstring; `_commit_count` inner comment; and transient-Git-failure test docstring. Retain `2*ceil(N/256)`, whole-chunk rollback/resume, and stderr-bearing retry behavior.
- `tests/interfaces/queries/test_next_batch_behavior.py` — docstrings on `test_childless_story_is_an_executable_leaf` and `test_childless_leaf_is_batched_regardless_of_ticket_type`. Retain the ADR 0078 child/container invariant, compatibility field, and `ready`/`next-batch` agreement.

Consumers are pytest, import/export and scheduling interfaces, and `check_comment_hygiene.py`. No runtime docstring reader was found.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the ten scoped blocks or adjacent blank lines change; normalized AST equality passes.
- [ ] Runtime strings, constants, assertions, decorators, and executable statements remain unchanged.
- [ ] The ordered shebang/directive inventory remains byte-identical.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and removes repetition, history, ornament, or obvious narration.
- [ ] A non-author reviewer posts one leaf-linked TSV row per edited block with immutable before/final citations, preserved contract/consumer, before/after words, and both verdicts.
- [ ] Every TSV row records `semantic-preservation=PASS` and `bloat-removal=PASS`; missing or failing rows block closure.
- [ ] The normalized guard, focused tests, comment-hygiene check, path-scoped `git diff --check`, and worktree-venv `make verify` pass.

## Verification
Run the recorded normalized-AST/allowlist/directive comparator; the three impacted test files; `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`; path-scoped `git diff --check`; and `make verify`. The independent TSV is authoritative for prose quality.
